Notes: 1) QuantFactor = model-specific quantization equivalence (ex: 8-bit radicals -> lower effective equivalence). We record EffectiveGPUEquiv to reflect cost accounting and capacity smoothing.
2) ScheduledBurstSlots = number of discrete burst windows per month where a customer can exceed base booked GPUs subject to policy.
3) BufferPct = operational buffer over booked capacity reserved for headroom; used in fairshare math.

Assumptions and rules (short):
- We normalize across quantization levels using QuantFactor (applied per contract in EffectiveGPUEquiv).
- Bursts are limited to ScheduledBurstSlots and subject to weekly smoothing; unplanned bursts consume the BufferPct first.
- If region headroom < 10% and queued bursts > 2, route bursts to fallback regions per AllocationPolicy.
- Billing metric for Dedicated customers uses EffectiveGPUEquiv * duration_hours; finance uses separate conversion for credits.

Open questions (for next sync):
- Confirm MedData on strict regional isolation vs. allowing encrypted KV replication for faster fallback.
- Tolerance for overcommit for Finudge during end-of-quarter spikes (finance signoff required).
- Whether to increase ScheduledBurstSlots for high-tier customers from 2->4 in holiday season window.

Action items: 
- Priya: produce adjusted per-customer monthly runway CSV for SRE by 2026-11-12 (PRIYA-TO-DO).
- Daniel: simulate 3-week simultaneous-burst scenario across us-east4 clusters and post results to GITHUB:infra/simulations (due 2026-11-14).
- María: confirm legal clause for regional isolation for MedData and share in #contracts (due 2026-11-09).
- Ops: Implement a short-term fairshare weight override API for emergency redistributions (ticket JIRA-ENGINF-1870).
short_summary: Working sheet to map per-contract GPU commitments into an 'effective' capacity pool (quant-adjusted), show regional headroom, scheduled bursts and smoothing windows, and capture open questions and action items.
notes: Draft version used in infra capacity sync. Contains provisional quant factors and sample scheduled burst allocations. Not yet finalized; figures subject to reconciliation with billing and SRE inventories.
